2 lifting both hands through chest to forehead level, shovel shaft angled up-left and spade moving behind her.

6 deep follow-through: shovel has continued down through that head-level contact, steel spade low in front, knees and torso settle.
7 recovery lifting the shovel slightly out of the low follow-through.
